question: National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) was set up in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**1988**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) was established by an act of Parliament in 1988.
 
• The main objective of NHAI is to develop, maintain, and manage the national highways and other major roads in India.
 
• NHAI operates under the administrative control of the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways.
 
• It is responsible for implementing the National Highways Development Project (NHDP), which is one of the largest highway projects in the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Highways Development Project (NHDP)**

 
 
• The NHDP is a project aimed at upgrading, rehabilitating, and widening major highways in India to international standards.
 
• The project is divided into several phases, each targeting different sections of the highways for development.
 
• One of the key components of NHDP is the Golden Quadrilateral, which connects four major cities: Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, and Kolkata.
 
• The NHDP also includes the North-South and East-West corridors, which further enhance connectivity across the country.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Road Transport and Highways**
 
 
• This ministry is a branch of the Government of India responsible for the development and maintenance of national highways and roads.
 
• It oversees policies and programs related to road transport and safety, aiming to improve the road infrastructure in India.
 
• The ministry works in conjunction with NHAI to implement various road projects and initiatives.
 
 
 
• **Bharatmala Pariyojana**
 
 
• Bharatmala Pariyojana is a centrally-sponsored and funded road and highways project of the Government of India.
 
• The project focuses on optimizing the efficiency of freight and passenger movement across the country by bridging critical infrastructure gaps.
 
• It aims to develop around 34,800 kilometers of highways in the first phase, enhancing connectivity across various regions.
